verdict.rationale: E2B supports several bulk-adjacent capabilities: up to 100 concurrent sandboxes, writing multiple files at once, listing all sandboxes, and shutting down single or all running sandboxes via CLI. However there is no unified batch/bulk API (e.g., no evidence of submitting a list of code executions or files to process as one bulk call) — bulk behavior is assembled from separate CLI/SDK primitives rather than a first-class bulk-operations feature. Missing for 10: a documented batch execution or bulk-processing API, evidence of bulk operations on non-sandbox resources (e.g., bulk template management), and independent/hands-on validation of bulk workflows at scale.
